ratings.comment: While he is not a bad professor, his lectures are difficult to sit through, and he always rushes through the material without much depth in his explanations. He will provide practice problems in class; however, they are done before the concept has been fully explained, making them hard to complete. Most of my learning was done independently of him.

Dr. Delong is the best math instructor I have ever had. He presents tough concepts in an extremely understandable and clear way. He uses a microphone and top hat questions to keep students engaged and involved in lecture. He is super funny and kind, and I can tell he cares a ton about our learning. If you take 234 at UW, make sure you get him!
